scenario.name: Small teaching workload
scenario.tagline: Three processes, four policies, arithmetic you can do on the board
scenario.description: The documented three-process example (P1 arrival 0 / burst 5 / priority 2, P2 0/3/1, P3 0/1/3) executed by the real FCFS, SJF, Priority and Round Robin classes with quantum 2 and no switch cost. Every waiting and completion time is checked against the hand calculation in the teacher guide.
scenario.expectation: Hand-verified means: FCFS 4.33, SJF 1.67, Priority 3.67, Round Robin 4.33 simulated time units per process.
